symptom: The exported v0.2 standalone request transcript digest accepted whitespace-only string values for freeze, settlement and revision scalar claims, although the strict authority-envelope preflight rejects blank claims. A caller could obtain a correlation digest for a malformed request graph. No independently verified authority or production impact was demonstrated.
lesson: A detached request graph can still violate the strict preflight's nonblank scalar contract if an exported standalone digest checks only string length. A well-formed hash is a correlation ID, not a valid or independently authenticated request.
guardrail: For standalone untrusted request transcript hashing, require trim-nonblank scalar claims on all freeze, settlement and revision string fields before correlation. Cover each of the twelve non-digest scalar positions with direct-call whitespace mutations and preserve valid transcript bytes. This is bounded scalar-shape admission, not timestamp/chain authentication, source finality, scoring permission or production authority.
